QuestInfo.name: Shining Sakura Emblem
QuestInfo.0: Haruaki has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.1: Haruaki has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.2: Haruaki has given you an Emblem.

0.0: I've been waiting for you #b#h0##k. I'm amazed at the progress you have made. It's rare to find such a natural Spirit Walker like you.
0.1: You are a vital figure, both in this world and our own. I made this gift for you. Consider it proof that I, Haruaki, recognize you as a great hero, and a remarkable friend. Please accept it.

no.0: But I made it for you! You can't refuse...

yes.0: We will defend this land with all our might. Your name will be spoken with admiration for generations to come. Stay true to the path of the spirits, friend.
